$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. A contract: the old profile's utility-contract (a customer account with a utility or service provider), now with a link to its counterparty. A counterparty is a role, not an entity type: it is an organization or a person.
title: Contract
description: A contract with a provider: who it is with, and the numbers that identify it.

counterparty.description: The organization or person the contract is with.

customer_no.description: The customer number at the counterparty.

phone.description: The counterparty's phone number for this contract.

email.description: The counterparty's e-mail address for this contract.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid: here, the end of the contract term. Empty means it does not expire.

allOf.description: A contract says who it is with.
